title: Out of the box
blurb: Edge to edge at 1920×1200, a 1.6× zoom toward each click and a spring-smoothed cursor. Three steps, nothing else set.

title: Framed on a matte
blurb: The page sits in a rounded window on a colour of your choosing, with an even border and a soft shadow.

title: A closer camera
blurb: Small targets read better closer in. Clicks close together share one shot, so the camera pans across the toolbar instead of bouncing.

title: Directing the camera
blurb: Tab clicks set zoom: false so the whole chart stays in frame as it changes. Hovers with zoom: true point the camera at a tooltip without clicking.

title: Captions by the cursor
blurb: A step's say line rides beside the cursor until the next step changes it. setup fills the expiry and CVC before recording starts.

title: Title, end card and brand
blurb: A lower-third title opens the take and an end card closes it. The brand file sets the ink, paper, ripple colour, display font, logo and footer.

title: Slow motion
blurb: Keyboard-driven UI moves fast. Playing at 0.75× slows the take, the cursor and the camera together, so the command palette has time to land.

title: A phone-width take
blurb: A 390×844 viewport renders at its own portrait shape instead of being letterboxed into 1920×1200. A matte frames it like a device.

title: Scrolling a long page
blurb: A scroll step glides the section into view on camera. A hover aims at a point inside its target with at: [fx, fy] rather than the centre.

title: A GIF for the README
blurb: upload attaches a file to a drop zone. --gif writes a 960px, 15fps GIF beside the MP4, and --hold rests on the last frame for a beat.
